coding_method: Manual conservative multi-label coding of original reviewer notes plus actual transcripts; categories overlap. Not an exhaustive call-level truth label or accuracy estimate. No confirmed MCP API/auth defect in these 42 trials. Unnecessary-call labels require inspection, not duplicate-input counts.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-baseline
trials.original_note: Initial absolute edit permission failed closed; no repair, repeated denied attempts.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-baseline-v2
trials.original_note: Static pass masked semantic error: guessed numeric 2 changes INFO to WARNING; invented removed LOGNOTICE.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-contract-skill-v4
trials.original_note: Correct source repair; guessed Matrix/Omega branch causes type-coverage failure. Independent Nexus pass cannot replace agent validation.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-nexus-skill-v5
trials.original_note: Actual skill loading, reproduce type error, minimal LOGINFO repair and all post-checks pass; recovered from one entry-point path guess.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-skill
trials.original_note: Initial absolute edit permission failed closed; no repair despite skill loading.

trials.label: coder-api-fix-skill-v2
trials.original_note: Minimal LOGINFO repair and before/after validation pass; intermediate explanation fabricated constant mappings.

trials.label: coder-boundary-baseline-v4
trials.original_note: Expected fixture-boundary denial; no retry or checker launch.

trials.label: coder-debug-baseline
trials.original_note: Unknown selected item was summarized as no selection.

trials.label: coder-debug-skill
trials.original_note: Skill never loaded; unknown selected item interpreted as absence.

trials.label: coder-debug-skill-explicit
trials.original_note: Loaded skill first; unsupported absence of an active container.

trials.label: coder-debug-skill-routed
trials.original_note: System routing did not trigger skill loading.

trials.label: coder-debug-skill-v4

trials.label: coder-explain-skill-v2
trials.original_note: Entry point and dependencies grounded; broad 19-22 compatibility and no-side-effect claims overstated.

trials.label: coder-review-baseline-v3
trials.original_note: Anchors accepted, but invented encryption/storage rules and unsupported blocker confidence; contract does not establish truth.

trials.label: coder-review-bounded-baseline-v4
trials.original_note: Invented deterministic no-sensitive-logging rule; revised final report not reverified; checker coordinates inaccurate.

trials.label: coder-review-bounded-skill-v4
trials.original_note: One source-supported potential privacy issue, original warnings separate; rejected coordinates corrected then reverified. Runtime and semantic limits retained.

trials.label: coder-review-composed-skill-v5
trials.original_note: Canonical checker composition works; model still overstates blocker severity and stdout mechanism; unnecessary extra validation.

trials.label: coder-review-skill-v3
trials.original_note: Improved cross-file privacy evidence; duplicated recommendations and unsupported demonstrated findings remain.

trials.label: coder-validate-default-baseline-v2
trials.original_note: Runtime branch fallback works; checker success and both warnings accurately reported.

trials.label: coder-validate-skill-v2
trials.original_note: Loaded validation skill/reference; actual static stages and both warnings accurately reported.

trials.label: coder-xml-baseline
trials.original_note: Correct closing-tag diagnosis; omitted branch exposed adapter process-exit 2.

trials.label: coder-xml-full-catalog-v4
trials.original_note: Selected appropriate skill from five; failed to read actual malformed manifest line.

trials.label: coder-xml-full-catalog-v5
trials.original_note: Selected validation skill from five and read actual manifest line after focused skill improvement; precise corrected tag and checker failure reported.

trials.label: coder-xml-skill
trials.original_note: Loaded skill and checker; incorrect explanation that a self-closing import needed closing.

trials.label: mellum-api-fix-baseline-v2
trials.original_note: Correct LOGINFO repair and post-check; omitted pre-check and misreported check/warning coverage.

trials.label: mellum-api-fix-contract-baseline-v4
trials.original_note: Correct minimal INFO repair and pre/post checks; recovered from one wrong fixture path.

trials.label: mellum-api-fix-contract-skill-v4
trials.original_note: Repair and pre/post checks pass; repeated bad manifest paths and step-cap output impair completion.

trials.label: mellum-api-fix-skill-v2

trials.label: mellum-debug-skill

trials.label: mellum-debug-skill-routed

trials.label: mellum-review-bounded-skill-v4

trials.label: mellum-review-skill-v3
trials.original_note: Wrong report envelope on verification; no final report after output-length exhaustion.

trials.label: mellum-xml-baseline

trials.label: mellum-xml-skill

trials.label: spark-xml-baseline-v3

trials.label: spark-xml-bounded-skill-v4

trials.label: spark-xml-skill-v3
trials.original_note: Correct closing-tag evidence, but final checker summary truncated.

limits: Few sequential pilot trials, not a ranking of models.
Completed tool events can contain checker/operational failures; inspect acceptance gates.
Token usage is cumulative SDK reporting, including repeated cached context.
Older trials lack complete initial provenance; reruns reflect documented instruction/tool changes.
Coordinates and static passes do not establish semantic truth or runtime behavior.
